# On and off by default — the `redux-toolkit` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#redux-toolkit).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** `package.json` depends on `@reduxjs/toolkit` or `redux`.
- **Rules:** 12 — 0 on, 12 on with `preview = true`, 0 off in an opt-in preset, 0 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `redux-toolkit/recommended` | yes, once the pack is installed | 12 | 3 error, 9 warn | The Redux Style Guide's Priority A rules as errors and its Priority B rules as warnings, where a rule has a deterministic match |

## Rules

`on` runs in a fresh install; a `preview` rule runs only with `preview = true` ([SR-RULE-PACKS](../../../records/0101_rule-packs.md) decision 9). † a preset `init` writes only when the repo has what it is for.
